source_policy: Each case is a test specification. No case in this file is claimed to have been executed or passed.

cases.precondition: A source-pinned theorem with no non-policy axiom dependencies and a trusted challenge.
cases.mutation: None. Build, export, kernel replay and independent replay all bind the same artifact digest.
expected_observations: Fresh closure is complete within declared coverage.
Official kernel accepts the exact export.
A distinct independent checker accepts the same export.
Challenge and solution target identities match.
must_not_emit: A generic claim that the informal theorem meaning is thereby proven.

cases.precondition: The proof depends on a foundational axiom explicitly allowed by a versioned policy.
cases.mutation: Add an explicit Classical.choice dependency and include its exact name in the policy allowlist.
expected_observations: The axiom remains visible in the closure.
The policy rationale and version are recorded.
Allowing the axiom does not erase it from the receipt.
must_not_emit: An empty axiom set.
A silent default allowlist.

cases.precondition: The root theorem directly uses a custom axiom not on the policy allowlist.
cases.mutation: Replace the proof body with a direct use of the custom axiom.
expected_observations: The custom axiom is named and classified.
Policy disposition is reject.
Official kernel replay may still accept the theorem relative to the axiom; that does not satisfy the trust policy.
must_not_emit: qualified_under_policy merely because Lean accepted the declaration.

cases.precondition: A helper theorem uses a custom axiom and the root depends on that helper.
cases.mutation: Move the custom axiom one or more declaration edges away from the root.
expected_observations: The transitive custom axiom appears in the root closure.
The edge path is retained for audit.
must_not_emit: A root closure containing only direct references.

cases.precondition: A root or transitive dependency is admitted through sorryAx.
cases.mutation: Insert sorry in the root or helper declaration.
expected_observations: sorryAx or the equivalent admission marker is explicit.
The policy rejects admissions by default.
must_not_emit: An admission treated as an ordinary proved theorem.

cases.precondition: Reproduce the two-module imported-inductive dependency case documented in Lean issue #15226.
cases.mutation: Audit imported structure S9, constructor S9.mk and theorem usesS9 in both root orders.
expected_observations: Fresh per-root traversal finds exactly Classical.choice for all three affected roots.
The cached/native diagnostic may disagree and is retained as diagnostic evidence.
The closure is invariant under root-order permutation.
must_not_emit: An axiom-free closure for S9, S9.mk or usesS9.
A claim that the Lean kernel itself accepted an invalid proof.

cases.precondition: A mutually recursive Even/Odd inductive family with constructors referencing the sibling type.
cases.mutation: Audit each inductive and constructor root in forward and reverse permutations.
expected_observations: All nodes and cycle edges are preserved.
Unknown coverage remains explicit until this declaration form is executed on the pinned toolchain.
must_not_emit: A universal completeness claim based on the S9 case.

cases.precondition: A dependency name is present but cannot be resolved in the imported environment.
cases.mutation: Remove or make inaccessible the imported declaration/artifact.
expected_observations: The missing name is retained with a reason.
No empty closure is generated.
must_not_emit: qualified_under_policy.
A zero-dependency result.

cases.precondition: The root depends on an opaque declaration whose value cannot be inspected under the selected environment/export mode.
cases.mutation: Remove the value-bearing artifact or use an environment that exposes only the opaque interface.
expected_observations: The node is classified opaque with value_availability unavailable.
The policy decides whether independent export replay can still qualify a narrower claim.
must_not_emit: An inference that opaque means axiom-free or dependency-free.

cases.precondition: A trusted challenge defines a specific target proposition.
cases.mutation: Supply a solution with the same display name but a different binder, hypothesis, type, universe or conclusion.
expected_observations: Comparator or equivalent identity check reports mismatch.
The root is not compared by short name or pretty-printed surface text alone.
must_not_emit: qualified_under_policy based on successful proof of the substituted target.

cases.precondition: The capsule binds a fixed source, Lean toolchain, Lake manifest and import artifact set.
cases.mutation: Change one source blob, imported olean, Lean revision, Mathlib revision or manifest digest.
expected_observations: At least one immutable input binding differs.
Old replay receipts are not reused for the new environment.
must_not_emit: Reuse of an exact-head receipt after an environment mutation.

cases.precondition: A theorem uses decide +native, bv_decide native evaluation, or another native-computation path.
cases.mutation: Run the same semantic fixture under each pinned Lean version and inspect the version-specific axiom/marker profile.
expected_observations: Native computation is detected and classified for the exact Lean version.
The reject policy is applied explicitly; a separately configured explicit allow policy creates a different cohort.
must_not_emit: A kernel-only or external-checker claim that the compiler calculation itself was independently verified.

cases.precondition: A tactic or plugin executes during elaboration and emits a conventional kernel-checkable proof term.
cases.mutation: Record the plugin as construction provenance while keeping it out of the final logical dependency graph unless the proof term itself references a declaration.
expected_observations: Logical dependencies and executable build components remain separate.
Without a declared sandbox/replay receipt, construction containment remains unknown.
must_not_emit: An unsafe modifier treated as sufficient evidence of malicious-code containment.
A claim that the plugin is a logical axiom dependency without an actual proof-term edge.

cases.precondition: An exported proof artifact is parsed and replayed outside the potentially adversarial build environment.
cases.mutation: Corrupt the export or inject an invalid declaration/proof object.
expected_observations: The relevant parser/checker rejects the artifact or reports an explicit error.
No checker error is converted into acceptance.
must_not_emit: qualified_under_policy.
A success receipt for an artifact other than the corrupted export.

cases.precondition: The official kernel and a separately implemented checker are configured for the same pinned export format.
cases.mutation: Run both checkers on byte-identical exported proof artifacts under recorded policies.
expected_observations: Both replay records carry the same export SHA-256.
Checker implementation identities and versions are distinct and recorded.
The axiom policy is explicit.
must_not_emit: Independent replay based only on two invocations of the official Lean kernel.

cases.precondition: The same official Lean kernel is invoked twice on the same export.
cases.mutation: Label the second invocation as an independent checker.
expected_observations: Both official-kernel runs may be recorded.
Independent replay remains unknown because implementation identity is not diverse.
must_not_emit: independent_checker_replay = satisfied.

cases.precondition: The official kernel and a distinct checker both process the same export.
cases.mutation: One checker accepts and the other rejects or errors.
expected_observations: Disagreement is preserved with raw logs and exact checker revisions.
No majority vote hides the disagreement.
must_not_emit: qualified_under_policy by selecting the favorable checker.

cases.precondition: A frozen set of roots includes cyclic and shared dependencies.
cases.mutation: Audit the exact same roots in multiple permutations.
expected_observations: Every root closure and canonical digest is identical across permutations.
A differing result fails the deterministic closure gate.
must_not_emit: A deterministic status based only on a single traversal order.
